name: Emberpup
notes: Emberpup: a red fox-puppy with a cream muzzle and chest and a flame at the tip of its tail. Type FIRE. Moves: Ember (A), Fire Spin (B) and Flamethrower (R). Walks at full speed: its move 1 (Ember) reaches 1 tile, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. Its moves hit 10 % softer than their power says (power 90 %), whether it is the player or a wild one, in every mode. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: EMBERPUP
